assertions.title: Bare no-input MCP object schemas remain callable for OpenAI-compatible tool use

steps.action: Register local yt-media MCP server on /mcp and inspect returned tool schemas
steps.expected: No-input schemas stay object-typed and open-object schemas preserve additionalProperties
steps.observed: Schema preservation checks passed (no-input object and open headers additionalProperties present).

steps.action: Run scheduled invocation against non-OAuth local MCP server
steps.expected: Tool call executes without OAuth consent gating
steps.observed: Run failed with OAuth-consent-required error even though server reports requiresOAuth=false.

assertions.issues: Fail: callable path still applies OAuth gating to a non-OAuth MCP server.

assertions.title: Arcade provider-consent prompts are surfaced as auth continuation, not MCP init failure

steps.action: Register pending-consent Arcade Microsoft MCP server and inspect /api/mcp/tools before consent
steps.observed: Server was not surfaced with discovered tools for this pending-consent state.

steps.expected: Run response includes continuation metadata (authorization_url and/or llm_instructions)
steps.observed: Continuation metadata fields were absent in run response.

assertions.issues: Fail: pending-consent tool discovery/continuation contract is still not met.

assertions.title: Diarization mode supports named speaker clips and disables prompts where unsupported

steps.expected: Invalid files rejected and valid reference accepted

steps.action: Upload main audio and queue diarization transcription with speaker reference
steps.expected: Job queues and completes with speaker-labeled transcript lines
steps.observed: Rerun with long-speech fixture completed and produced speaker-labeled output (`[A]: ...`).

assertions.title: Model restrictions are enforced server-side across config, chat, agents, and assistants

steps.action: Apply strict model allowlist and verify restricted model catalog
steps.expected: GET /api/models and config surfaces reflect filtered access including modelSpecs surface
steps.observed: /api/models filtered correctly, but /api/config omitted modelSpecs surface entirely.

steps.action: Probe blocked-model enforcement across agents, assistants, assistant chat, and model chat
steps.expected: Blocked surfaces return model-access errors rather than success or unrelated ban errors
steps.observed: Agent and assistant/chat probes returned Illegal model request consistently in clean rerun without ban contamination.

assertions.issues: Fail: contract requirement for filtered modelSpecs in config response remains unmet.

frictions.description: Anti-abuse ban/rate-limit middleware contaminates high-volume negative-path probes with temporary-ban responses.
frictions.resolution: Used seed+API-restart recovery and split blocked-model assistant/chat probes across multiple personas to capture clean model-access errors.

frictions.description: Initial diarization fixture produced no detectable speech despite successful queue/execution path.
frictions.resolution: Reran with long-speech fixture and obtained completed transcript with speaker label markers.
